_comment: The stall roaster's build (#925, #711): each stage after the iron frame and its materials, from StallRoaster/README.md's stage table and the rig's build.stages, in order; read by Machines/Core/MachineBuildJson.cs (its schema); README 'Ore machines: what they share'. The brickwork is any one fired brick (oneType: the first sets the stall's brick type, which the front's loose walling then takes too; the codes are the rig's bricks.types, red first for the creative shortcut); a click puts in as many of the held stack as the stage still needs. The front's walling and the outlet's cap are not stages (StallRoaster/Game/BEStallRoaster.cs). No part wears.
